sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the existing ship target, applicability alternatives, accessibility requirement, canonical datatypes and metre unit, and the equivalent direct-calculation comparison 10 * availableSurvivalEquipmentCapacity >= 11 * personsOnBoard. Reject the current storageDistanceToMusterOrEmbarkation constraint because a required metre-valued QuantityValue with only presence/cardinality and a descriptive message is a presence-only approximation of the verified “as close as practical” stowage requirement.
